howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose DPI
howto.text: Lower DPI for smaller files; GIF is limited to 256 colors so detail loss is acceptable for previews.

howto.name: Download a ZIP of GIFs
howto.text: Each page becomes one GIF file. Useful for embedding PDF previews in legacy systems.

faq.a: GIF's 256-color palette quantizes the page. Text remains readable but gradients and photos show banding. Use PNG for higher quality.

faq.q: Does this make an animated GIF?
faq.a: No — each page is one static GIF. To make a flipbook-style animation, use Video to GIF after converting to images and back.

faq.q: How big are the output files?
faq.a: Typically 30-100 KB per page at 96 DPI.
